To further validate the reliability of this LLM-based quality review process, we conducted an additional manual evaluation. We randomly selected 500 QA pairs from the HoH-QA dataset for this manual assessment. Each QA pair was evaluated by human annotators based on the four primary quality dimensions covered by our automated pipeline: Same Answer Check, Answer Accuracy, Question Clarity and Completeness, and Temporal Independence.
